attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 5 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and says outright that nothing more is known: «Δεν έχουμε άλλες λεπτομέρειες για τον βίο του Αγίου». That is a want of knowledge and not saint.gr's asterisked refusal to vouch for an entry; the page carries no asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence. This is neither the corpus's `christopher`, the martyr of 9 May whose Greek row is already venerated on that day, nor `christopher-the-roman`, the venerable of 30 August: saint.gr keeps this man alone on 5 June and gives him a martyrdom by the sword. The page gives no year and prints no hymn.
